articles.title: At least 11 people die in a stampede in India as fans celebrate cricket championship
articles.description: At least 11 people are dead and more than 30 injured after a stampede on Wednesday as crowds tried to enter a cricket stadium in the southern Indian state of Karnataka, authorities said.
